messages:
Mina (docs): Hi all — opened a small PR to add an explicit "audit evidence" example for SOC2 reviewers. It covers export package format, consent metadata, and a short retention snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2560 :wave:

Carlos (security): Nice. Please include the exact server-side default redaction keys (ip_address, user_email, api_key, auth_token) and a statement that server-side redaction is authoritative.

Leah (legal): For "full-export" opt-ins, legal requires a stored consent record: consent_id, consent_ts, requester_id. Add a short consent JSON example in metadata.

Dan (eng): I can add curl + python examples for fetching the export and verifying SHA256. Also call out header `X-Redwood-Export-Version: 2`. Small note: actor ids are now string prefixed by type (e.g., "user:u_42").

Priya (devex): Please include a one-liner showing how to request redaction-first vs full-export via the API (query param or body flag). Many users ask for that during migrations.

Mina (docs): Draft now has: 1) export package JSON sample; 2) consent metadata snippet; 3) retention example (hosted default 90d); 4) short migration diff for user_id -> actor.id.

Carlos (security): Add integrity guidance: TLS + AES-256 at rest and include SHA256 checksum in export metadata for reviewers to verify.

Leah (legal): Also add legal-hold workflow: how to request, how we store legal_hold_id and how retention changes while hold is active. Mention region-specific retention obligations.

Dan (eng): Implementation note for docs: the purge worker soft-deletes (sets deleted_at) then purges blobs 30 days later. Useful to show sample purge log line for evidence.

Priya (devex): I'll draft a tiny Python streaming snippet for downloads and include the header example. Keep snippets as one-liners where possible.

Mina (docs): Great — I'll update the PR with these points and ping Carlos/Leah for final review. CI: please run linkcheck after I update the cross-link to /integrations/audit-exports.

CI-bot: docs/pr-2560  build passed, linkcheck ok :white_check_mark:

Mina (docs): Thanks — plan to merge tomorrow morning if no objections. :shipit:
